The following events took place in '''5,956 BBY'''.

==Events==
*Members of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] develop a [[Arkanian heavy pistol|heavy blaster pistol]] design. {{C|Approximate date}}<ref name="productiondate">Both ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' state that the Arkanian heavy pistol was created two thousands years before the games. According to the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', the first game occurred in [[3956 BBY]] and the second game occurred in [[3951 BBY]]. This article treats 5956 BBY as the approximate date for the creation of the weapon.</ref>
